visualCharacteristics: Centered grid of people/team cards. Each card has a circular portrait, a name, a role/description line, and a row of social icon links. No border or card background.
contentPattern: One row per person, cells: image cell (portrait) + body cell (name heading + role heading + social links).
usage: About Us page 'Our Contributors' (4-up) and 'WKND Guides' (3-up) grids.
